metadata.document: EDS Special Update: Fast-track Under Scrutiny

cleaned_body_text: Fast-track is ramping up, but so is our oversight of the new system. This is a special update on our recent fast-track work. Amendment Bill: a bad law made worse. Henry VIII Clause: EDS letter to the Attorney-General. BusinessDesk report: a likely surge in judicial reviews. Waihi North draft decision: out now. EDS comments on TTR. Southland Wind Farm: EDS invited to comment. Santana’s Bendigo gold mine: now in the running. Cost Recovery: how much and by whom? Ombudsman correspondence: release of pre-lodgement consultation information. Read the Special Update in full here.
